answer: LIST n, d, c, w FROM Satscore [has SchoolStatusType: 'Closed'] has SatscoreAvgScrWrite w AND ALSO has SchoolSchool n AND ALSO has SchoolDistrict d AND ALSO has SchoolCounty c WHERE w < THE MAXIMUM w2 IN Satscore [has SchoolStatusType: 'Closed'] has SatscoreAvgScrWrite w2 ORDERED WITH w DESCENDING THE FIRST 1 WITH TIES

LIST co, cnt, round(af, 2), round(ap, 2), c1, c0, round(sa, 2) FROM Frpm x [has SchoolCounty: 'Alameda'] has SchoolCounty co AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 f AND ALSO has FrpmCountK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e AND ALSO has FrpmCharterSchoolYN ch AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SatscoreAvgScrMath m AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SatscoreAvgScrRead r AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SatscoreAvgScrWrite w AND ALSO round(f / e * 100, 2) AS pf AND ALSO round(k / e * 100, 2) AS pk AND ALSO (m + r + w) AS sat AND ALSO if(ch = 1, 1, 0) AS i1 AND ALSO if(ch = 0, 1, 0) AS i0 AND ALSO THE COUNT OF x GROUPED BY co AS cnt AND ALSO THE AVERAGE pf GROUPED BY co AS af AND ALSO THE AVERAGE pk GROUPED BY co AS ap AND ALSO THE SUM OF i1 GROUPED BY co AS c1 AND ALSO THE SUM OF i0 GROUPED BY co AS c0 AND ALSO THE AVERAGE sat GROUPED BY co AS sa WHERE f > 500 AND k < 700
note: K-12 read as the K-12 count columns; schools with SAT records = all three section averages present
